sections.heading: Overview
bullets: Wing 5's capstone fight. Normal mode is comparatively forgiving; the real difficulty (and most of the named mechanics below) shows up hard in Challenge Mote.

sections.heading: Key mechanics
bullets: Green Shackles (Soul Shackle): links two players together — if they get too close, both souls destroy each other. Keep shackled pairs apart.
Death Mark: a scythe slam that rips souls from anyone hit by the initial blast — reunite body and soul quickly or it's a kill. A stronger Greater Death Mark variant also exists.
Dhuum's Messenger add appears during the fight — don't ignore it while focused on the boss.

sections.heading: Enrage
bullets: 10:00 soft enrage from 100%→10% (Dhuum's outgoing damage jumps +500%), then a hard 1:45 window from 10%→0% that wipes the squad outright if missed.
